title: Permutation of product inputs
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a type, let $n$ be a natural number, and let $\sigma$ be a permutation of the coordinates $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. The map sending each input $x:\mathrm{Fin}(n)\to\Omega$ to the input whose value at $i$ is $x(\sigma(i))$ is an equivalence of the product input space with itself.
hypotheses_covered: $\sigma$ is a permutation of the $n$ coordinates
